units.reason: Test-only constructor swap required by the new groupBreaker type; no production effect.

units.headline: OpenAPI cache-hit test uses two-step breaker

units.summary: Adds a longRunning gauge vec to the metrics struct and updates the doc comment. Fields are internal, but the struct drives exported Prometheus series.
units.headline: routerMetrics gains a long-running watches gauge
units.reason: Internal struct field addition backing a new metric; the behavior lives in instrument and newRouterMetrics.

units.summary: Watches are now counted in a long-running gauge and excluded from the in-flight gauge and duration histogram. The histogram gains a verb label, which changes the exported series shape and dashboards or alerts that use it.

issues.title: Unbounded verb label allows metric cardinality growth
issues.evidence: if err != nil || info.Verb == "" { return strings.ToLower(req.Method) } ... WithLabelValues(metricGroup, verb, strconv.Itoa(rec.status))
issues.failure_scenario: A client sends requests with arbitrary HTTP methods (e.g. FOO1, FOO2, ...) to any path, including unknown groups. Each distinct lowercased method becomes a new verb label value and a new native-histogram series, although the group label is bounded to prevent exactly this.

units.headline: Watches leave the histogram and in-flight gauge; verb label added
units.reason: Changes metric semantics and labels, request flow and defer ordering, and the logging path for watches.
focus: dashboards and alerts using http_request_duration_seconds without the verb label
verb label cardinality for arbitrary methods
watch access log still emitted on panic or abort

units.summary: Adds a router-wide context and cancel used to end all watches at shutdown. Runtime behavior is implemented in serveWatch and stopping.
units.headline: GrafanaRouter gets a context to end all watches
units.reason: New lifecycle and cancellation state affecting concurrency and shutdown of in-flight requests.
focus: endWatches is initialized in every construction path of GrafanaRouter
stopping calls closeWatches before listener shutdown

units.summary: Upgrade requests to routed groups now get a 400, and watch requests run through serveWatch so they end when the backend is replaced or the router closes. Ordinary requests are unchanged.
units.headline: Routed watches get cancellable scope; upgrades rejected with 400
units.reason: Changes request handling, rejects a class of requests, and adds cancellation of streaming requests.
focus: clients that previously relied on Upgrade/WebSocket through the router
a request that loaded an old snapshot just before reconcile ends its scope
rejectUpgrade runs after group lookup, so Connection: Upgrade is rejected even for non-watch requests

units.summary: The unregistered-group handler (single-tenant fallback) now rejects upgrades with 400 and wraps watches in serveWatch, scoped only to router shutdown.
units.headline: Fallback handler rejects upgrades and wraps watches
units.reason: Changes request handling and cancellation for the fallback path.
focus: fallback watches are not tied to a backend scope, only to router shutdown
upgrade rejection on the fallback path

units.summary: New file: identifies watches via the apiserver RequestInfoFactory, rejects Upgrade requests, and serves watches under a cancellable context ended by backend replacement or router shutdown. It swallows ErrAbortHandler panics when the router itself ended the watch so the client sees a clean end.
units.headline: New watch lifecycle: scoped cancellation, upgrade rejection, verb detection
units.reason: New concurrency, panic recovery and request-classification logic on the proxy hot path.
focus: recover only swallows ErrAbortHandler when the router canceled and the client did not
requestVerb fallback for non-resource paths and arbitrary methods
context.AfterFunc stop functions are deferred so no leak per request
closeWatches only ends watches served through serveWatch
